title: Mempool Surf Club Explore — Network Research Registry
scope: Research-only NETWORK registry. No public Explore pages, routes, Atlas/Shopify/runtime wiring, or production changes are authorized.

registry_wide_rules.one_entity_one_profile: One canonical entity = one profile; use relationships instead of duplicates.
registry_wide_rules.lifecycle: Status is independent from deployment maturity, adoption, compatibility and source confidence; a reachable website or old repository alone does not prove ACTIVE.
registry_wide_rules.consensus_policy: Bitcoin protocol, implementation consensus behavior, standardness, mempool policy, relay policy, mining policy, wallet behavior and indexer interpretation are distinct. Bitcoin Core is not the Bitcoin protocol; Knots policy differences do not by themselves imply different consensus rules.
registry_wide_rules.lightning: Lightning Network/BOLTs are distinct from LND, Core Lightning, Eclair, LDK, wallets, LSPs and payment processors. Lightning is not a blockchain.
registry_wide_rules.observability: Explorer labels/estimates and network measurements are not consensus state. Reachable-node counts are not all nodes; public Lightning graph/capacity is not total liquidity or economic activity.
registry_wide_rules.maturity: Proposal, specification, merged support, optional support, default behavior, deployed use and broad adoption are distinct.
registry_wide_rules.cross_category: Bitcoin Core wallet stays WALLETS; approved mining protocols stay MINING; BTCPay Server stays PAYMENTS; ZEUS/Phoenix/Blixt stay WALLETS; ord stays ORDINALS/RUNES.

required_record_fields: Why it matters in the Bitcoin network ecosystem

command_center_review_queue.issue: Preserve Bitcoin protocol vs implementation and consensus vs policy distinctions; wallet remains WALLETS.
Do not equate policy differences with a consensus split; reverify current release/policy details before publication.
Active client development is verified; Utreexo-related proposal/deployment maturity remains qualified.
Reverify version/implementation-specific support for fast-moving Lightning features before public copy.
Describe hosted-node custody, availability and operational trust boundaries precisely.
Counts/geography/version shares require current dates and methodology caveats.
Public graph data omits private channels and does not measure total Lightning liquidity/economic activity.
Keep HISTORICAL/MEDIUM unless current canonical maintenance is newly verified.
Deployed specification does not mean universal adoption; encryption is not authenticated peer identity.
Specialized relay/trust model is distinct from ordinary Bitcoin P2P; current operator claims are time-sensitive.

omission_decisions.reason: Fork-chain software, not current Bitcoin node canon.
Historical blocksize-era significance does not outweigh fork-chain scope ambiguity for initial NETWORK canon.
Represent under rust-bitcoin; avoid dependency-directory padding.
Better canonical fit with WALLETS/developer tooling.
RTL and LNDg sufficiently cover node-management archetypes without tool-directory expansion.
Specialized test infrastructure is narrower than initial canon.
Represent under canonical implementations/backends rather than one profile per feature/BIP.
Preserve proposal/implementation/deployment maturity instead of implying broad deployment.
External privacy networks, not Bitcoin-specific entities.

omission_decisions.entity: Stratum V1/V2, getblocktemplate, BetterHash, DATUM, P2Pool, Braidpool

omission_decisions.reason: Weaker current/unique canon evidence than selected self-hosted platforms.

consolidation_decisions: Esplora + Blockstream Explorer + blockstream.info -> one profile.
Amboss Space + Magma + analytics/liquidity surfaces -> one Amboss profile.
Umbrel -> one platform profile; Start9/StartOS -> one platform profile.
Libbitcoin toolkit/server lineage -> one Libbitcoin profile.
Floresta + Utreexo relationship -> one Floresta profile plus relation.
Greenlight remains separate from Core Lightning because hosted operation is materially distinct.
FIBRE and Bitcoin Relay Network remain separate because active successor and historical predecessor have distinct technology/lifecycle.
